name: Tech Mahindra Ltd
title: Tech Mahindra Ltd - 532755 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Tech Mahindra exited FY26 with Q4 margin 13.8% (up 70bp QoQ) and FY27 EBIT target of 15% reiterated, but growth is still soft at 0.6% CC for FY26 with no hard numbers on volume or pricing.

triggers.label: Q4 EBIT margin 13.8%, 10 quarters up
triggers.quote: We've now had 10 quarters of margin expansion, so going from an exit margin of 6.4% to 13.8% in the most recent quarter.

triggers.label: Q4 deal wins USD 1,073m, up 35% YoY
triggers.quote: The deal wins for the quarter stand at 1,073 million, up 35% YoY, and reflects continued deal momentum.

triggers.label: Revenue YoY exit ~4.9% reported
triggers.quote: almost a 5% year-on-year on a reported basis in the most recent quarter

triggers.label: Industry growth 2-5% estimate, no firm FY27 number
triggers.quote: maybe the industry growth would be in the 2%-4% or 3%-5% range.

guidance.quote: We are reiterating our FY27 financial targets
achieving organic constant currency revenue growth above our peer group's average
our commitment to all of you is get to 30% for next year

red_flags.label: Hedge book down 62% YoY
red_flags.quote: Compared to March '25, which is last year, our hedge book is lower by 62% from 1.96 billion.

red_flags.label: Dividend payout 104% of PAT
red_flags.quote: The full year dividend payout ratio works out at 104% of PAT and 91% of free cash flow, above our stated capital allocation policy.

red_flags.label: Telecom client pressure
red_flags.quote: there is a concern about a couple of large accounts in telecom where some of your competitors are calling out business specific pressures

evasions.quote: we have not reported a number that you might have been expecting, which is around the revenue from AI
there's always a revision on that percentage of dependencies on growth versus on cost actions
